title: Gluten-Free Orange Pudding Bread Pudding
description: A moist bread pudding infused with orange zest, perfect for a gluten-free dessert. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together pudding mix and 1 cup of milk until well combined.
Add the cubed bread to the pudding mixture and stir until the bread is evenly coated.
Add the orange segments and zest to the bread mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the pudding is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
